detaileddescription.para: The SPI driver provides API to configure the SPI module. Below are the high level features supported by the SPI driver.

listitem.para: Controller & Peripheral operational modes with 125 different programmable baud rates (upto SYSCLK/4)
1 to 16 data bits per word, 4 standard SPI clocking schemes
Supports simultaneous receive and transmit operation, delayed transmit control
SPIPTE inversion for digital audio interface receive mode on devices with two SPI modules
Support for DMA, High Speed SPI, 3-wire SPI

simplesect.para: It is strongly recommend to use SysConfig where it is available instead of using direct SW API calls. This will help simplify the SW application and also catch common mistakes early in the development cycle.

listitem.para: Configurable data width, SPI mode, emulation behaviour
Separately configurable TX & RX FIFO settings
Integrated support for interrupt & RTDMA modules

simplesect.para: To use SPI with custom pin combinations, select one of the predefined options under Use Case, or select "Custom" to configure each pin as required.

sect1.title: Example Usage
